CORE PRINCIPLE: THE 28-TILE TRIANGULAR NUMBER SECRET
Why are there exactly 28 tiles? Count them by their highest pip: 7 tiles have a 0
6 new tiles have a 1 ([1|1]..[1|6]), 5 have a 2, down to 1 tile with a 6 ([6|6]).
Sum: 7 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 28! Dominoes are triangular numbers made tactile!
★ EXTENSION INVESTIGATION: FIND ALL SUM-TO-7 TILES
Can you find all 3 tiles that sum to 7: [1|6], [2|5], and [3|4]? Why is there no [0|7]
tile in a double-six set? (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)
